description:
LANDED a010532e8 (2026-09-01; cold review ACCEPT-WITH-CHANGES + refuter
FIX-THEN-MERGE, all fixes folded; gate lib 1532/0, cli 23/0, matrix
425/0/9, clippy/fmt clean).

MECHANISM (probe-verified): schedule-dependent demand came from ascent
HISTORY: conclude_preserving_frontier + join-on-upsert kept every
superseded conclusion's row in ActivationInputs forever; the chains
tripped ACTIVATION_INPUT_ROW_BUDGET=8 under one schedule and not the
other (FIFO: 10 rows -> columnwise collapse -> 1 wide row -> wide cone of
14 predicate specs; LIFO: 8 rows at budget by luck -> 3 narrow targets),
and collapse CASCADES (a collapse mints wide keys whose analyses
contribute wide rows downstream). Chains are the schedule-visible part;
per-callsite maxima are schedule-independent.

TWO FIX SHAPES REFUTED BY PROTOTYPE (do not rebuild): replace-on-conclude
and subsumption-gated ascent-replace both NON-SETTLE (12,401-collapse
ping-pong across the 8/9-row budget cliff through the cont<->step
2-cycle). Grow-only row sets are load-bearing for termination.

THE FIX: dominance absorption at insert_row -- a dominated incoming row
is not inserted; standing rows dominated by the incoming row leave.
Types::row_column_dominates(sub,dom) := sub==dom || (free_var_ids equal
&& lit_arrow_shapes(sub) SUBSET lit_arrow_shapes(dom) && is_subtype),
memoized via non-symmetric ComparisonKey::RowColumnDominates;
lit_arrow_shapes RECURSIVE (refuter found the depth-1 hole: nested
closure lits in tuples/lists evaded the top-level walk and produced
MUTUAL dominance; recursive walk measured behavior-neutral, depth-1
guard test added). The closure-literal conjunct exists because
emptiness.rs::func_clause_empty decides closure-arrow P\N from
fn_id+captures alone (args/ret never read), so is_subtype alone judges
differently-specialized arrows over one lambda equivalent -- unguarded
absorption miscompiled with_index (JIT tag panic). Free vars are
NOMINAL on their own axis (is_subtype(int,a)=false both ways).
Transitivity by construction; antisymmetry/confluence and termination
EMPIRICAL (corpus mutual-dominance 0, point-in-time). Budget stays as
the termination backstop, now observed via a real telemetry event
(budget_collapsed; counter on Types because collapses fire in
join_assign where Types is the only reachable handle -- the
flush_reported_warnings producer/drain shape at the World boundary;
fz-0xp holds the sink-shape question).

MOVEMENT (all classified, classification gate per fz-zih): predicate
217->203 = base-LIFO exactly, FIFO==LIFO BYTE-IDENTICAL canon on all 4
gated lenses (predicate/00420/00183/range_map); 13 corpus canon movers
= 6 fewer execs + 5 same-with-narrower-types + 2 rises (00420 twins
207->215 PAIRED with budget collapses 30->0 -- precision replacing
collapse-widened sharing); 577-fixture stdout+exit sweep 0 movements
(interp; JIT+AOT verified on lenses + 00277); corpus budget collapses
88 events/3 fixtures -> 0; wall clock 0.77-1.00x on lenses. Claims pin
174->173 (spec's 172 was a review-time projection from the prototype
relation; 173 is measured), analyze take_drop 805->742 (below the
pre-105 787 -- fz-kdt.110's watched rise repaid). Pins re-pinned with
recipes and causes.

KNOWN RESIDUALS (ticketed): equivalence-skip arrival-order hole
ENLARGED at head (row COUNT now arrival-dependent, corpus-unreachable
today) -- fz-0za owns the fold; 00277's schedule gap is NOT this class
(incomparable transient rows at a 3-arm same-predicate callsite) --
fz-kdt.107 owns it; collapse-cascade work-ratchet fixture -- fz-zih;
telemetry sink shape -- fz-0xp; stall-diagnostic set-order (sweep
comparand noise) -- fz-kdt.109.

Every one of the surviving 14 carries the same over-wide join 'int | :false | :ok | :true' (Enum.all?/1#lambda@4125-4170/2, three Enum.all?/2#lambda@4286-4337/2, Enum.all_value_step/1, Enum.empty?/1#lambda@4753-4792/2, Kernel.</2, Kernel.==/2, Kernel.fz_op_eq/2, Kernel.fz_op_lt/2 and siblings) -- i.e. the 21 that vanished were the clause-ORDER class and the 14 that remain are exactly this ticket's transient-wide-join class, now isolated with nothing else mixed in. 00420 and 00183 are fully key-confluent FIFO vs LIFO at both base and head.
